description: One fresh V7/V3.9 tabular Q-learning model trained for 30000 rounds against one peaceful_agent, using the same world/agent seed pair 21/20021 as the 15000-round experiment. Epsilon decays from 1.0 to 0.05 after 20000 completed rounds and remains at 0.05 for the last 10000 rounds. All other learning, feature and reward versions are preserved. Frozen evaluation uses the same five held-out seed pairs for 200 rounds each, collecting self-kill and pressure-chain diagnostics directly in the per-seed result JSONs, without replay recording. This comparison changes both training duration and the exploration schedule.
